text: dsh-devreg 是面向 DSH 的本地开发服务登记查看插件，通过注册 DSH 工具读取用户机器上的项目服务登记文件。它可以按项目列出服务及其端口、状态和环境 URL，找出多个服务登记了同一端口的情况，并检查登记文件是否可读取。适合希望在 Harness 会话中查看本地开发环境信息的开发者。插件读取 ~/.dev-registry/projects/*.json，可用 DEVREG_ROOT 指定目录；不要求 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-devreg adds local development inspection tools to DSH. It lists services by project, finds duplicate port claims, and checks whether local registry files can be read. It reads ~/.dev-registry/projects/*.json; DEVREG_ROOT can select another directory. No API key or external service is needed.
想在 DSH 会话里查看本机登记了哪些开发服务。
帮我找出哪些本地服务占用了同一个端口。
Show me the development services recorded on this machine in DSH.
dsh-devreg 的功能「查看登记服务」：在 DSH 调用 devreg_status，可选择按项目名称筛选；工具读取本地项目登记文件并返回服务记录。
dsh-devreg 的功能「发现端口冲突并检查注册表」：调用 devreg_conflicts 查看登记了重复端口的服务组，或调用 devreg_doctor 检查本地登记文件是否能读取并返回服务数。

dsh-devreg README · dsh-devreg：Read your local development services from DeepSeek Harness.

[中文说明](README.zh.md) · [GitHub](https://github.com/jiayanzhao666/dsh-devreg)

`dsh-devreg` is a standalone, read-only DeepSeek Harness plugin package. It shows the services, ports, statuses, and environment URLs recorded in `~/.dev-registry/projects/*.json`. It does not require a separate CLI installation and never changes the registry.

dsh-devreg README · Features：- Inspect registered services from a Harness session.
- Find multiple services claiming the same port.
- Check whether the registry files are readable.
- Use the same data from the `devreg` command-line entry point.

dsh-devreg README · Quick start：Clone and build the project:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/jiayanzhao666/dsh-devreg.git
cd dsh-devreg
npm install
npm run build

Add the checkout to a Harness profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile devreg add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-devreg
```

Remove it later with:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile devreg remove dsh-devreg
```

The profile gets these tools:

dsh-devreg README · Quick start：| Tool | What it does | Input |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `devreg_status` | Lists registered services. | Optional `project` filter. |
| `devreg_conflicts` | Finds duplicate port claims. | None. |
| `devreg_doctor` | Checks that registry files can be read. | None. |

dsh-devreg README · CLI：Run the local CLI through npm:

```sh
npm run devreg -- ports
npm run devreg -- conflicts
npm run devreg -- doctor
npm run devreg -- export

The CLI is read-only as well. If no project files exist, list commands return an empty result.

dsh-devreg README · Data source：The plugin reads project files under:

```text
~/.dev-registry/projects/*.json
```

It reads service names, ports, status, commands, container metadata, project paths, and configured environment URLs when those fields exist. It does not start another process, synchronize Docker state, run `devreg serve`, or write `index.json`.

dsh-devreg README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run build

Node.js 22 or newer is required.
